#Course-Exam: Programming Foundations
**Objective of the Course Exam:** The course exam aims to assess your understanding and knowledge of the course content and determine your performance in the respective course. It serves as a means to evaluate your readiness and proficiency in the subject matter.
**Eligibility Criteria:** To be eligible to attempt the course exam, each topic must be marked as complete. Double-check the course curriculum in your schedule to make sure each session and course item is marked as complete.
**Grading:** Upon completion of each course, you will be assigned a course-wise exam, and your performance will be graded based on the following criteria: | Grade | Grade Point | Exam Score % |Exam Marks(100) | :---: | :-------: |:-------: |:-------: | | A | 10 | >80% | >=80 | | B | 8 | 60-80% | 60-79 | | C | 6 | 40-60% | 40-59 | | D | 4 | 20-40% | 20-39 | | E | 2 | <20% | <20 | For the Programming Foundations course exam ***achieve Grade A (min. 80/100 marks)***
**Cumulative Grade Calculation:** An overall cumulative grade will be assigned based on your performance across all courses within your chosen job track. The cumulative grade reflects your overall progress and success in the program.
Cumulative Grade = (Sum of all the course Grades present in the Job Track) / (Number of courses present in the job track)
**Course Exam Attempts:** You can attempt the course exam multiple times to improve your grade. Each attempt will allow you to demonstrate your understanding and enhance your performance. - It is crucial to maintain good grades throughout the program as it can increase the number of job opportunities available to you. - Recruiters will have access to your grades and performance during the program, and this information may be considered when evaluating candidates for job openings.
**IRC (Industry-Ready Certification) Eligibility Criteria:** To be eligible for the Industry-Ready Certification (IRC), you must fulfill the following criteria: - Achieve a ***cumulative grade of a minimum of 7.5/10*** - Complete all projects with given requirements and pass all plagiarism checks - Complete Project Verification & Viva - Please note that while your grades play a significant role in achieving IRC, they are not the sole determining factor. - Other factors, such as project performance, project verification, and viva, are also considered in evaluating your readiness for the industry.
**Refrain from Malpractice** Instances of **malpractice, cheating,** or **copying** during the course exams are taken seriously and may result in severe consequences, including but not limited to **disqualification from the exam, invalidation of exam results, invalidation of further Placement Support, or further disciplinary actions as per the program's policies**. - We urge you to **uphold the principles of honesty, integrity, and ethical conduct** throughout the exam. - Your individual efforts and genuine understanding of the course content are essential for your personal growth and success. - To ensure a fair and transparent examination environment, we expect all participants to adhere to the following guidelines: - Do not engage in any form of cheating, including but not limited to copying answers from others, using unauthorized materials, or seeking assistance from external sources during the exam. - Avoid communicating or exchanging information with other participants during the exam, whether in person or through online platforms. - Refrain from accessing unauthorized resources, websites, or applications that may provide an unfair advantage. - Use only the allowed resources, if any, as specified in the exam instructions. If specific materials or resources are permitted, ensure they are used within the defined boundaries.
**Aviod Technical issues** 1. Here is a document that will help you avoid technical issues when taking the course exam. 2. Attempting the Mock Practice Test to check your laptop/system supports the test environment.

Remember to prepare thoroughly for each course exam, review the course material, and seek clarification on any doubts before attempting the exam. All the Best!!
